Strategy: Count-gated band preference: with fewer than four feasible bins, score by tightest fit; with four or more, strongly prefer residuals in [item, 2*item) and penalize larger residuals, so large bins stay open for future large items while small residuals are consumed first. It can fail when preserved large bins never receive a fitting large item, wasting capacity tight packing would have used.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    n = len(bins)
    return [(1000.0 - (r - item) if (n >= 4 and r < 2 * item) else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
